draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.65, the 232nd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 18th of 20 at S. He went 239th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Seattle Seahawks. 68 career games and 26 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 0.0% (99th percentile). Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), approximate value 1 (11th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 safety who played: 12.9% season snap share against a median of 72.3%, below the norm.
